comments.author: Sakura
comments.body:
You could compare to Aztec Calendar (15m from Tenoch, 20-25m bazaars), except:
-Because it has an effect, it will not decay as you sail
-Putting in bank is WAY cheaper (for sailing in pirated waters/fighting in dungeons): 500 compared to 750,000 I believe

So it is worth either the cost of buying multiple calendars (due to decay/plunder) or the cost of putting a calendar in your Vault (+750k each time).

That is it's WORTH...but what it sells for, I have no clue.
